CustomShader.description: Intendent to be used with placeables\nhas special placeableColorScale parameter, which used by lua code, to indicate in the game, if this object can be placed or not\nCan be used as a replacement for baseShader, if you need snow/wetnes

Parameter.name: placeableColorScale
Parameter.description: W>0 - blend XYZ to diffuseColor, usually used for in-game placement color

Parameter.name: porosityBySmoothness
Parameter.description: X - porosityAtZeroRoughness\nY - porosityRoughnessSlope (set it to 0.0 if you don't want darkening)\nporosity = X + roughness * Y;

Parameter.name: yOffset
Parameter.description: X - offset vertices of the mesh (localSpace) in {0,1,0} positive direction\nuses uv1.x (second UVset) as gradient to control offset intensity\nuv1.x == 0 - no offset, uv1.x == 1 - X offset

Parameter.name: hideArea
Parameter.description: area of uv0 (first UVset) which needs to be hidden\nuv0.x in range [X,Y]\nuv0.y in range [Z,W]

Parameter.name: hideSectionStates
Parameter.description:
uv0 placed in 4 udims (u1v1,u2v1,u3v1,u4v1)
X - hides u2v1 (uv0.x in range 1..2)
Y - hides u3v1 (uv0.x in range 2..3)
Z - hides u4v1 (uv0.x in range 3..4)

Parameter.name: hideShiftOffset
Parameter.description: moves uv0.y by X in the given rectangle (hideSection)

Parameter.name: hideByIndex
Parameter.description: hide sub-mesh with index > X\nY - amount of indexes

Parameter.name: harvestPosition
Parameter.description: XYZ - current harvest world postion // shaking center point\nW - harvest intensity

Parameter.name: shakeScale
Parameter.description: XY - max xz offset // localspace vector with built-in shaking intensity\nZ - max intensity\nW - max distance // controls shaking mask radius

Parameter.name: mossLevel
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] control the intensity of the dirt/moss mask

Parameter.name: bool_displacement
Parameter.description: X - use terrain displacement or not (1 - True, 0 - False)

Parameter.name: heightMask
Parameter.description: X - [-1..1] control the blending area between the mesh and VT Terrain

Parameter.name: scrollPos
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] animation frame (scrolling time based parameter)

Parameter.name: prevScrollPos
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] same as scrollPos, but from previous time step (set by LUA)

Parameter.name: hidePieces
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] hides subElements of the mergeChildren

Parameter.name: animationIntensity
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] controls the intensity of the vtx animation

Parameter.name: blendScale
Parameter.description: X - [0..1] controls the blending for the mCustomDiffuse

Texture.name: mSnowSpecular
Texture.description: shared snow specular\nNote: mSnowSpecular.G - ambient occlusion used as alpha for snow blending gradient

Texture.name: mAlphaMask
Texture.description: blend mCustomDiffuse to diffuseColor via mAlphaMask

Texture.name: animationArray
Texture.description:
array of 2 R16G16B16A16_FLOAT textures
animationArray[0] - position(XYZ transaltion, localSpace) of the pieces
animationArray[1] - orient(XYZW quaternion rotation, localSpace) of the pieces
texture sampled using samplerBilinearClamp filter, so interpolation for values in-between(pixels) comes for free
Note: quaternion rotations must be compatible (this should be done on content side)

Variation.name: rockDetail
Variation.description:
adds mNormalDetail.xy to normalMap, using snow tri-planar uv's
adds mMossDetail to diffuse, using snow tri-planar uv's
mNormalDetail.z - multiplied with roughness (mixing roughness with smoothness )
diffuseColor.rgb multiplied by snowSpecular.g (snowSpecular.g contain values between 0.7..1.0)

Variation.name: wind_vertexOffset_hideAlpha
Variation.groups: base uv1Attr vtxOffset colorAttr hideArea hideSection
Variation.description:
wind + vertexOffset + hideAlpha
hideAlpha - intendent to be used with specificly made uv's
if sectionState = 0 set alpha = 0 if texel is within a given rectangle defined by the shader parameter hideArea
sectionIndex is taken from uv0.x > 1

Variation.name: vertexOffset_hideUVShift
Variation.groups: base uv1Attr vtxOffset hideArea hideShift hideSection

vertexOffset + hideUVShift
hideUVShift - intendent to be used with specificly made uv's for LOD's
moves uv's by hideShiftOffset in the given rectangle
sectionIndex is hard-coded and equally spaced (uv0.x - divided on 3 parts)
controled via hideSectionStates
